root_cause_evidence: Earlier profiles showed repeated writer admission and small independent replay/durability publications.
The ae7 ten-minute run retained 70,419 closed artifact aliases after workers closed; ordinary bounded orphan cleanup did not keep pace with runtime/source churn.
Deferred closed-lease release reduced the next ten-minute storage peak from 366,911,488 to 17,879,040 bytes, with zero growth after warmup. Throughput and active visibility still failed.

A fresh queue-candidate profile showed short segment-metadata merge scans opening durable per-run sources during foreground/runtime refresh. Scoped cursor catalog reads remove those publications while preserving a captured read epoch.

The a5e ten-minute run completed 18,223 writes and passed active visibility/storage but still failed sustained throughput. Its stopped catalog contained 102 tiny SSTs and only five recovered mutable WAL entries.

LLDB traced immutable rotation/flush through LSM obsolete-reclaim maintenance. noteRecoveredWriteMutationLocked marked every reconstructed dirty cache immediately due. Native checkpoint-age continuity separates these cache opens from unknown-age restart recovery.
candidate_design: Prepare full-text inputs outside writer admission; group index and progress publications with exact inode/catalog/recovery validation.
Preserve durable native WAL across cache refresh; distinguish durability from immutable checkpoint creation.
Account file-wide replay debt atomically, including prepared reservations, and refuse producer work before primary commit. Release leases while waiting; committed outcomes remain non-retryable.
Close artifact readers and markers before enqueuing preallocated unique-key release hints. Bound deletion batches, requeue failures, check inode, and retain orphan recovery.

Explicit short metadata scans use one captured catalog view for table-index and data-block reads. Cached values own bytes independently; ordinary cursors and persistent segments retain artifact-specific protection.

A refused producer waits on a footprint hint and cheap durable aggregate reads without registry/runtime/file pins during sleep. Actual commit rechecks exact credits; inode/catalog changes request revalidation.

confirmed_reservation_refusal.cause: The reservation multiplied intentAdmissionBytes (values plus 4096 bytes per intent and key bookkeeping) by nine, although the journal encodes only key-reference lists.
confirmed_reservation_refusal.fix: Persist independent replacement-aware replay key bounds and preserve existing intent/retained-frame accounting; reserve catalog-derived artifact key references independently of vector payloads. RAB2 fences old replay-accounting writers; RAB1 and legacy descriptor readers remain supported.

key_bound_validation.source: Uncommitted local follow-up on bf14c1c32d; ignored source manifest records changed-file hashes.
key_bound_validation.root_cause: Replay reservations multiplied full intent-memory admission by nine although thin journal records contain key references, not primary values. A replacement could wait for its own prepared reservation.
key_bound_validation.fix: Persist replacement-aware replay key-reference bytes independently of memory and retained-frame accounting; derive vector artifact references server-side; exchange credits atomically on resolution and release on abort.
key_bound_validation.compatibility: RAB2 replay-accounting writer fence; 40-byte intent descriptors, 32-byte member accounting; legacy descriptors retain conservative bounds. Physical format and C ABI unchanged; compatible writer versions required.
